entities.name: Rafael Lledó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rafael Lledó was an Argentine basketball player who competed in the 1948 Summer Olympics and in the 1952 Summer Olympics. Lledó was born in Santiago del Estero on 2 March 1922. died on 9 August 1991, at the age of 69.
